ModMetaData.name: RimworldTCG
ModMetaData.description: Rimworld TCG is a medium-weight balanced mod that brings trading cards with practical uses as well as a collectors activity. From no effect to massive stat bonuses, RimWorld TCG has it. Bulk cards? Craft harder ones with them! Found every card in the expansion? Create a powerful collection with the best stat bonuses in the set! Finding these cards comes from a variety of tasks, or they can be bought outright from traders.
